title: Forces, Magnets and the Water Cycle Unit Test
subject: science
unitTitle: Forces, magnets and water in nature

items.prompt: A child drags a box towards herself across the floor. State the force she is using and give the reason.

points.text: Names the force as a pull
Gives the reason that the box is brought closer to the child

items.prompt: Two magnets are brought together with their north poles facing each other. Explain what happens and why.

points.text: States the magnets push each other apart because like poles repel
Links the repulsion to both facing ends carrying the same pole

items.prompt: State the process by which liquid water changes into water vapour at the surface of a pond.

points.text: Notes it happens at the surface and needs heat from the surroundings

items.prompt: A cold mirror held above a kettle of boiling water becomes covered in droplets. Explain how the droplets form.

points.text: States water vapour from the kettle touches the cold mirror
States the vapour loses heat and condenses into liquid droplets

levels.label: Secure
levels.descriptor: Answers use the correct force and process names and link each observation to a cause.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Force and process names are mostly correct but the cause link is incomplete.

levels.label: Beginning
levels.descriptor: Force and process names are missing or confused and no cause is given.
